 Advertisement Who is Anthony Constantino? Everything you need to know about the NY-21 candidate
 Anthony Constantino Advertisement Updated: 3:16 PM EDT Oct 22, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Michael Cusanelli Digital Content Manager Who is Anthony Constantino? Everything you need to know about the NY-21 candidate
 Updated: 3:16 PM EDT Oct 22, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Michael Cusanelli Digital Content Manager PLATTSBURGH, N.Y. — Anthony Constantino is a New York businessman who is running as a Republican for the New York 21st Congressional District seat. He is running to replace incumbent Elise Stefanik, also a Republican, who has held the district's seat for six terms.
 Constantino's opponent is Democrat Blake Gendebien, a Northern New York dairy farmer.
 Advertisement But who is Anthony Constantino, and what issues is he campaigning on? 
 Background and printing business
 Constantino is an Albany, New York, native who founded the online print company Sticker Mule in Amsterdam, New York. The company is headquartered in New York but has multiple locations internationally, according to Constantino's website.
 Constantino took over his father's print company, Noteworthy, at age 19 after Tom Constantino died. 
 Constantino then founded Sticker Mule in Amsterdam before acquiring Noteworthy and absorbing its employees, according to his official campaign website.
 In addition to his company, Constantino took up professional boxing at age 40. In 2026, Constantino released a rap album called "Thank You, President Trump".
 Constantino is a proud supporter of President Donald Trump and has garnered attention for the large "Vote for Trump" sign on top of the Sticker Mule headquarters.
 Poll shows tight race for New York’s 21st Congressional District What issues does Anthony Constantino support?
 Constantino has campaigned on issues including stricter immigration policies in the North Country by securing the Northern Border, as well as making life more affordable for Northern New Yorkers. 
 He has also campaigned to deliver faster internet and cell service to the region and to bring down the price of utilities, including cuts to regulations on green energy.
 His website also details his stance on other policies including his support for fracking, Immigration and Customs Enforcement, and tax cuts for the North Country.
 New York 21st congressional Republican candidate Anthony Constantino sits down with NBC5 Anthony Constantino answers our questions
 NBC5: What is one attribute or skill that you would bring to the position of New York 21 Representative that your opponent would not? 
 Constantino: I am an expert in creating American jobs, having built an Upstate New York company which paid out more than $600 million in wages to local people in recent years. While I love creating American jobs, Blake Gendebien insults local workers and brags about his preference for illegals.
 NBC5: What makes you uniquely positioned to handle the biggest issues that impact North Country voters in the 21st Congressional District? And how will you work to meet the needs of voters both Democrat and Republican? 
 Constantino: I have a track record for helping all people by creating thousands of jobs and philanthropically spending more than $4 million of my own money to uplift the community. I will help all people on a bigger scale in Congress.
 NBC5: Why is winning this office important to you? What is your biggest motivator in taking on this role? 
 Constantino: The Democrat Party is destroying New York State and I am self funding to reverse that trend by fighting for good ideas that make our lives better. I want secure borders, more upstate jobs, and, most of all, to stop corruption because stopping corruption is necessary to lower costs.
 NBC5: If elected, what is the first thing you would work to try to change using the power of your office? 
 Constantino: I will introduce Operation Overhaul: Legislation to catalog, display, redesign and improve every government software system so that we can all use government services more easily. I also will fight for funding to improve internet and cell coverage in our district, and will expand access to remote medicine so that Upstate New Yorkers get better healthcare at a lower cost.
 NBC5: I want you to speak directly to the voters who may be on the fence about you. What is your message to them, and why do you think you are the right person for this job? 
 Constantino: I enjoy helping people and always deliver results. In Congress, I’ll bring back jobs, lower costs, and make people excited to build their lives in upstate again. I’m fully self-funding my campaign, and even donating my entire Congressional salary to a wounded veteran because all I want to do is help.
 Who is Blake Gendebien? Meet the candidate running for NY-21 What part of New York would Anthony Constantino represent if he wins the NY-21 race?
 New York's 21st Congressional District spans multiple counties in the North Country and Upstate New York. It includes Clinton, Essex, Franklin, Fulton, Hamilton, Lewis, St. Lawrence, Warren, Washington and most of Jefferson counties. It also includes parts of Herkimer, Saratoga, Oneida, Montgomery and Schoharie counties, according to the latest district maps on Congress.Gov .
